$comment: What this repository contributes to a running stack, and what a check may
believe about it. `checked` is proved against this repository by
internal/manifest/manifest_test.go in this repository's own CI; `declared` is
a statement nobody can verify and carries its own `why`.
IT REFUSES TO BE AN OPEN PROXY, AND THAT REFUSAL RUNS BEFORE ANYTHING BINDS.
A non-loopback bind with no credential is an unauthenticated fetch proxy on
somebody's network, and the failure is silent: it works perfectly for
whoever finds it. So the check is a matrix rather than a sentence, and all
four corners are run:
loopback, no keys                      starts
0.0.0.0, no keys                       REFUSES, exit 1
0.0.0.0, no keys, ALLOW_OPEN_BIND=1    starts, because somebody said so
0.0.0.0, with keys                     starts, because there is a credential
The two escapes are the point. A check that only proved the refusal would
pass just as well on a component that refuses ALWAYS, which would be a
different and broken thing.
IT ALSO REFUSES WITHOUT A POLICY PLANE, and the code says why in its own
words: it fails closed, so an unconfigured one would refuse every fetch with
a message about the network instead of about the configuration. That is the
only unconditionally required variable of seventeen.
NO HEALTH PATH IS DECLARED BECAUSE THERE IS NONE. Its surface is an MCP
server, and no launcher polls it: stack-up registers the pid and moves on,
stack-single gives the service no healthcheck. Declaring one would be a
sentence a launcher could act on and be wrong.

the_browser_backend_is_a_separate_image.why: The chromium backend needs a browser this binary does not carry, which is why stack-single builds `stack/scopyx-browser:dev` only when asked and calls it a separate compose profile. Not checked here because the claim would be about an image built in another repository.

the_deployments_bind_it_wider_on_purpose.why: A container reaches its peers on no other interface, so both server deployments bind wide and supply SCOPYX_KEYS. That is the fourth row of the matrix above rather than an exception to it: the refusal is about a bind with NO credential, not about the bind.
